message.content:
This editorial illustration features a stylized magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red block letters. Below it, the text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline is "DEBAT-DEBATAN CALON PRESIDEN," followed by smaller text about presidential teams preparing for debates. Additional headlines include "Komitmen COP28 dalam Gempuran Energi Fosil H.112" and "Karpet Merah TikTok Shop H.94."

The cover depicts five caricatured human figures clustered around a white podium and a black microphone stand. The figures are illustrated with exaggerated facial features, such as large noses and expressive eyes. 

Starting from the top right, a figure with dark hair and closed eyes rests his chin on his hand. Below him is a man with white hair and wide eyes, appearing to shout. To the lower right, another figure with dark hair and glasses leans in. In the center, a figure with his eyes tightly shut holds a microphone. On the left, a man with round, black-rimmed glasses and a clenched jaw looms over a figure in the bottom left wearing a black hat and rectangular glasses. The characters overlap in a dark blue space, with some gesturing with their hands. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner, next to "11-17 DESEMBER 2023" and "RP 50.000."
